title: Publish an album
description: Prepare, publish, and manage visibility of albums on your artist page.

blocks.content: Albums live in **Dashboard → Albums**. A draft stays private until you publish it. After publishing, the album can appear on your public artist page and in search, depending on visibility settings.

blocks.subtitle: Publish an album
content: Complete the album editor and upload tracks.
When all required fields are filled, use **Publish** on the album row.
Your email must be verified to publish content.

blocks.subtitle: After publishing
content: You can hide an album from visitors while keeping it published (**Hidden** visibility).
Edits to a published album may be saved as draft changes until you update the live version.
Use track visibility settings to control which tracks, stems, or downloads are public or subscriber-only.
